definitions.explanation: The activity of pursuing and capturing wild animals.
Used as a suffix for gathering activities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紅葉|もみじ}→紅葉：05387_momiji⟧{狩|が}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.notes: [Note: 狩り becomes がり as suffix]

examples.japanese: ⟦{鹿|しか}→鹿：04347_shika⟧{狩|が}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧。
⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧、⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧{狩|か}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かけていた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: My father used to often go hunting when he was young.
When autumn comes, it's our family tradition to go strawberry picking or grape picking.

notes:
{狩|か}り means hunting or gathering.

AS HUNTING:
- {狩|か}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to hunt)
- ⟦{猪|いのしし}→猪：04349_inoshishi⟧{狩|が}り (boar hunting)
- ⟦{鹿|しか}→鹿：04347_shika⟧{狩|が}り (deer hunting)
- ⟦{狐|きつね}→狐：04337_kitsune⟧{狩|が}り (fox hunting)

AS GATHERING (suffix ⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧):
- ⟦{紅葉|もみじ}→紅葉：05387_momiji⟧{狩|が}り (autumn leaf viewing)
- ⟦{潮干|しおひ}{狩|が}り→潮干狩り：18507_shiohigari⟧ (shellfish gathering)
- ⟦きのこ→茸：04994_kinoko⟧{狩|が}り (mushroom hunting)
- いちご{狩|が}り (strawberry picking)
- ぶどう{狩|が}り (grape picking)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{狩人|かりうど}→狩人：noentry⟧ (hunter)
- ⟦{狩猟|しゅりょう}→狩猟：13507_shuryou⟧ (hunting - formal)
